_comment: door_chain_fight's start -- the FULL end-to-end FIGHT-leg canonical (the 'route is the subject' script per FIXTURE-FIRST POLICY's own exception; it USED to be the one script that proved Erin's beat-1 flicker line fired for real, see the INTERIM note below). CONSTRAINT: post_game structurally implies the FULL Act II/III backbone (acts.json's counted_among beat; test_fixture_coherence.gd enforces it), so this fixture carries the near_act3/climax_sealed_start Act III-complete shape alongside the harness-tuned 'warrior5_mage5' build -- this is the one door-chain fixture whose OWN canonical resolves real fights at a pinned seed, so the combat-relevant fields (classes, weapon, rng_state) are exactly the tuned/measured ones (test_fixture_coherence.gd's exact-build combat-band check pins the 10-level total). met_relc banked so Relc fields as an ally in both live fights (rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian ship allies:[relc]/ally_requires:{met_relc:1}, matching the gated 0.55-0.95/0.55-0.8 cells rather than the harder ungated _solo variants). INTERIM UNTIL 2.4 WIRES THE MOUNTING SCENE; RE-DERIVE THEN (2026-07-26 main-quest restructure, Task 2.2): `door_chain_started` + `door_that_goes_elsewhere` are now PRE-BANKED here, matching door_chain_talk_start/door_chain_scout_start. Erin no longer starts the chain (her option became a pointer at Ceria's dig), and the new start -- the pantry mounting scene -- does not exist until Task 2.4, so this canonical cannot play its start leg live at this phase. Task 2.4 restores a played-through start and un-banks these two. door_understood/pedestal_unsealed/etc. still stay UNBANKED: everything from the Pisces consult onward is played for real. Positioned directly facing Erin (7,2), where the old beat-1 leg began -- the script now teleports straight to Pisces from there. gold 40 (position ledger's Tier-A honest Act III income (docs/design/fixture-position-ledger.md), pre-catalyst-spend) covers Krshia's 35g catalyst with headroom. Equipped `relcs_spare_spear` (the tutorial gift) over the starter rusty_sword -- warrior's own L1 grants BOTH power_strike (sword) and piercing_strikes (spear), so the family swap only trades one weapon-tagged skill for its sibling; both live fights (rift_vermin_leak, ruin_guardian) land victories at this exact rng_state with the spear equipped. times_slept 12 (cosmetic -- only rotates the request/delivery board slate, never visited by this canonical). rng_state governs both live fights. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=3, captured .state = -7684921244414978279), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. RE-DERIVED (issue #83): ruin_ward_a/b's `guard` adoption made the ruin_guardian fight measurably harder (sim_combat_batch.gd's ruin_guardian_w8_relc win_rate 0.69 -> 0.59 after the accompanying combatants.json retune) -- the OLD .seed=1 state (-1966449618399012673) still won rift_vermin_leak but now LOST ruin_guardian at this exact draw, so a fresh state was seed-searched (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd) until BOTH live fights won again; .seed=3 was the first candidate to also hold for door_chain_sequence_break_start's own opposite-order run (see that fixture's own TRAP comment) and was kept for both together.
_comment_task_2_3: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): horns_dig_started + horns_dig_joined added. anchor_stone_pedestal's contains_when now also gates on horns_dig_joined (quests.json horns_dig's no-cosmetic-skip rule), so this legacy door-chain position only opens the pedestal as a POST-BACKFILL save does -- Task 2.6 banks exactly these two for any old chain save. The pedestal open here now also banks pedestal_breached + door_retrieved; that is the same one-event canon (you cannot hold the anchor stone without having breached and retrieved).
